text:
Alex: quick async — pushed a draft PR (#4123) that reduces lock hold time in the batcher. bench A p95 down ~8% and tail looks cleaner. still seeing a small bump on very short seqs.

Priya: nice. can you paste the perf snippet?

Alex: here, ran the local latrun: 
```
./bench/latrun.sh --profile=batcher-stallhunt --iters=200
old p95: 72ms -> new p95: 66ms
old p99: 210ms -> new p99: 198ms
```

Marco: looks good. short seq bump — could be due to our microbatch cutoff change? did you touch slotting?

Alex: only minimized the lock around queue pop; I did adjust the microbatch deadline from 5ms -> 3ms in the experiment branch (to reduce head-of-line).

Jen: curious if KV cache warmup is affected. saw a couple of LRU evictions on the run. which eviction threshold are you using?

Alex: test used kv.threshold=0.8 (same as prod), but in the experiment I lowered the prefetch size. I can rerun with larger prefetch.

Sam: FYI CI flaked on the canary harness earlier (timeouts). ci-bot retried once. @ci-bot can you drop the failure logs?

ci-bot: rerun triggered by @Sam. failed job: canary-integration (timeout at 15m). logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4123/canary-failure. Retries: 1, last status: running.

Lila: for the short seqs bump, try increasing batching.min_batch_size to 2 for a run — that often smooths the tail. also add a tiny linear backoff on the microbatch deadline.

Alex: will try two quick runs: (1) bigger prefetch, (2) min_batch_size=2 + micro-deadline 4ms. aim to post results by EOD. cc @Jen for KV impact.

Priya: also ping PR reviewers: @Marco and @Jen please take a look when you can. quick notes in PR about the lock region and expected perf delta. :eyes:

Marco: skimmed the diff, left one comment about the histogram buckets. otherwise looks safe to me.

Jen: adding a KV regression test to the canary now. if it remains green I'll +1.

Alex: thanks. small FYI: the rollback plan is trivial — revert the config tweak and tag the old release.

Sam: assuming canary passes, we should schedule a small rollout (10% traffic, 30m) then monitor p99 and KV hit-rate.

Alex: agreed. I'll add rollout config to the PR and a short runbook snippet.

Priya: great. any blockers?

Alex: only waiting on one CI green and Jen's KV test. otherwise none.

Jen: KV test queued, ETA ~25m.

Alex: cool — I'll post final numbers and merge once green. :shipit:
